contea di ritrovamento: West Sussex (Inghilterra e Galles)

A complete Roman struck or hammered copper alloy contemporary copy Magnus Maximus AD.383-388 nummus, Reece period 20, dating AD383-388. The obverse shows bust of emperor right. Legend:MA[...]MAXI[M]VS P [...]. The reverse shows camp gates with a signal gateway, one star above. LVGS mint mark underneath the camp gates. Legend: [SPES ROMANORVM]. The coin is 12.34mm in diameter, and weighs 0.82grams
